release_title: TopUp Net Gateway v1.0.8 (Signed Webhooks, Durable SMS Queue & Signing Security)
changelog:
- Signed Webhook Delivery: Added HMAC-SHA256 timestamp + nonce verification headers for webhook and status requests.
- Durable SMS Queue Worker: Serialized WorkManager retry pipeline with SQLite persistence so queued payment SMS never get dropped offline.
- Smarter SMS Filter & Inbox Scanner reliability improvements.
- Rotated release signing key lineage for verified in-app updates across Android 7 through Android 16.
